title: Midnight Chinese Noodles
description: A creative Italian-inspired take on traditional Chinese noodles, featuring midnight black squid ink noodles, savory zhajiang sauce, and crispy sesame seeds.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the midnight black squid ink noodles according to package instructions until al dente.
In a pan, heat the peanut oil over medium heat and add the minced garlic. Cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the zhajiang sauce and chinese jiang to the pan and stir to combine. Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Add the mian noodles to the pan and stir to combine with the sauce. Cook for 2-3 minutes.
Serve the noodles hot, garnished with sesame seeds, green onions, and a drizzle of soy sauce and sugar.
To make the zhajiang sauce, combine the zhajiang sauce ingredients in a bowl and stir to combine.
To make the chinese jiang, combine the chinese jiang ingredients in a bowl and stir to combine.
To toast the sesame seeds, heat a pan over low heat and add the sesame seeds. Cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant and lightly browned.
To chop the green onions, thinly slice the green onions and chop into small pieces.
To mince the garlic, peel the garlic cloves and chop into small pieces.
To cook the noodles, bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the noodles according to package instructions.
To cook the sauce, heat a pan over medium heat and add the sauce ingredients. Cook, stirring frequently, until the sauce thickens.
